description: V7R-010: v7 master end. U3 own SDA pin (K), test pads A/B, grounds C (C9.1) and N (C10.1), +3.3 V pads X.

blocks.text: v7 main board, top side, master end: ESP32 module U3 and the SDA/SCL test pads.
Zoom: K = U3's own SDA pin. A/B = test pads. C, N = ground. X = +3.3 V.

markers.label: K
markers.legend: SDA at U3's own pin: U3 pad 37 (module edge pad)

markers.label: A
markers.legend: SDA test pad (TPIO43, green wire soldered)

markers.label: B
markers.legend: SCL test pad (TPIO44, yellow wire soldered)

markers.label: C
markers.legend: Ground: C9.1, the upper end of capacitor C9

markers.label: X
markers.legend: +3.3 V: the other end of C9. Never bridge to C

markers.label: N
markers.legend: Ground: C10.1, the upper end of capacitor C10 (V5 tips only)

markers.label: X
markers.legend: +3.3 V: the lower end of C10, between N and X/C. Never touch

blocks.text: Rendered from the v7 KiCad layout (commit {commit}). Pad positions are from the layout file, so check under the microscope before probing.
